description: This source file implements advanced operational functions for the CCSP CWMP Processor component, including environment setup/teardown, handling timers, re-delivering events, and managing transfer events via PSM for the TR069 protocol.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoEngage(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bRestart)
methods.description: Enables the processor object to activate; initializes environment if not active.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoCancel(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Deactivates the processor object, stops timers, and cleans up environment.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoSetupEnv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,BOOL bRestart)
methods.description: Sets up the operational environment, including message bus registration, parameter cache, and configuration.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoCloseEnv(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Closes and cleans up the environment; placeholder in current implementation.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoPeriodicTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Triggered periodically to send Inform or other scheduled actions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoScheduleTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Triggered when a scheduled timer fires, typically to initiate a scheduled Inform.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoPendingInformTimerInvoke(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Handles pending timer events, transitioning session state if needed.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoRedeliverEvents(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Re-delivers all undelivered events such as transfer and state change completions.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoGetUndeliveredEvents(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hWmpSession)
methods.description: Resets session with all pending undelivered events.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoGetUndeliveredTcEvents(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hWmpSession)
methods.description: Adds TransferComplete events from PSM to session.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoGetUndeliveredAtcEvents(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hWmpSession)
methods.description: Adds AutonomousTransferComplete events from PSM to session.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoGetUndeliveredDscEvents(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hWmpSession)
methods.description: Adds DUStateChangeComplete events from PSM to session.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS CcspCwmppoGetUndeliveredAdscEvents(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hWmpSession)
methods.description: Adds AutonomousDUStateChangeComplete events from PSM to session.

methods.description: Saves transfer complete details into PSM.

methods.name: CcspCwmppoLoadTransferComplete
